hooks.command: tj_hook -- python3 -I -B -c "import hashlib, os, runpy, sys, tempfile;from pathlib import Path;package_root = Path(sys.argv[1]);package_digest = sys.argv[2];configured_snapshots = os.environ.get('TJ_AGENTS_STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY', '');plugin_data = Path(os.environ.get('PLUGIN_DATA', '')).resolve();snapshots = Path(configured_snapshots) if configured_snapshots else plugin_data / 'hook-snapshots';snapshot_key = hashlib.sha256((str(package_root) + chr(0) + package_digest).encode()).hexdigest();loaders = (base / 'hooks' / 'codex' / 'snapshot.py' for base in (snapshots / snapshot_key, package_root));newline = chr(10).encode();sources = (loader.read_bytes().replace(chr(13).encode() + newline, newline).replace(chr(13).encode(), newline) for loader in loaders if loader.is_file());source = next((candidate for candidate in sources if hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest() == '43b2b800fd10d444f0aea8a865409d31499be16dcbccd3bc0c75f92b623f6acd'), None);source is not None or (sys.stderr.write('Codex hook snapshot loader integrity check failed' + chr(10)), sys.exit(2));workspace = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();staged = Path(workspace.name) / 'loader.py';staged.write_bytes(source);runpy.run_path(str(staged), run_name='__main__')" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "sha256:9afc232d162579210d6ec5ecb13d6147e8ac8b3f258b06e6d5540116ee6ce0d2" "agent" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook_dispatch.py" --deadline 7 --hook "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/.agents/agent/utility/peer/scripts/register_session.py"
